_purpose: Hand-curated DATA (not code): src/icytower/*.c files that scan_src_defs.py's --list-build-files would otherwise mechanically add to build.cmd's compile lists (they define a real, interop_index.json-recognized game function) but that do NOT actually compile-and-link cleanly into the carrier today, for a reason that has nothing to do with the MSVC-vs-GCC-x87 split --list-build-files itself decides. Consulted by scan_src_defs.py (excluded from both the msvc and gcc lists, with a warning) and by gen_bind_table.py (no binding-table row is generated for a function whose only defining file is blocked here, since there would be nothing linked for the row to point at). Remove an entry the day its file's missing symbols are wired up (asset-seam integration, tracked separately - see src/icytower/ASSETS.md) and it will pick itself back up automatically on the next build, exactly like any other src/icytower/*.c file.
